collocations.en: keep warm with a wood stove

why: ζεσταίνομαι = keep warm, not 'heat the house'

collocations.en: inspiration struck him; he got carried away

why: 'είναι σε οίστρο' reads as 'in heat'; 'ο οίστρος της στιγμής' rare; replaced with frequent idiom

collocations.en: the bones are placed in the ossuary
it was all decided in advance

why: 'προαποφασισμένη υπόθεση' is not idiomatic Greek; ειλημμένος (already taken) is not a near-synonym
αβεβαιότητα is not a true opposite

gloss: early repayment, prepayment; discounting (of cheques, bills); (fig.) taking for granted
why: added the banking sense 'discounting' used in the collocations

collocations.el: οι σκεπτικιστές για την κλιματική αλλαγή

why: genitive 'σκεπτικιστές της κλιματικής αλλαγής' is a calque
standard terms are συναισθηματική νοημοσύνη / συναισθηματικός δεσμός; replaced
bank-account sense is the one met most often (and in the example)
άλσος (grove) and σύμπλεγμα are not near-synonyms of 'cluster, clump'
'υπνικός κύκλος' is not used; Greek says κύκλος ύπνου
διάφανος is not a true opposite of 'tinted'
σέλφι is not a near-synonym of a painted self-portrait
ομογενής covers any diaspora Greek, not a near-synonym
